standard-dialogue.npc: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need another assignment.

steps.text: If the player has a high combat level:

steps.npc: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Vannaka under Edgeville to assign you a task?

options.text: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.

steps.player: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.

options.text: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.

steps.player: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an assignment yet:

steps.npc: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].

options.text: Got any tips for me?

steps.text: Achtryn provides the corresponding Slayer task tip.

options.text: Okay, great!

steps.npc: Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment, and they have become ineligible for this assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.

options.text: Yes, please cancel it.

steps.npc: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.

options.text: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

steps.player: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.player: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.npc: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.

options.text: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.text: If the player has disabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

options.text: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.player: That's fine - I can handle any task.

options.text: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.player: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will now take the player's combat level into account.
If the player has enabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

options.text: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.player: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.

options.text: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.player: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will no longer take the player's combat level into account.

options.text: So you're filling in for Mazchna?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Mazchna?

steps.npc: Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.

steps.player: So do you know Mazchna well?

steps.npc: Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.
Though, of course, you know that already. Sorry to babble on. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.

options.text: Er... Nothing...
I need another assignment.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
Err... Nothing...

getting-a-task-bypassing-the-combat-leve.npc: Your cape attests that you are experienced enough to be taught by me. I will overlook your lack of experience in combat.
